messages:
nina: Quick ping 11 postmortem Action Item #2 (telemetry cleanup for private deploy logs) is overdue. Owner: omar. Any status? We need closure before next customer audit. :alarm_clock:

omar: Apologies, hit a blocker with log retention policy diff between private and hosted. Have a branch that normalizes fields but still iterating on retention TTLs. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4621. ETA for final tests: 48h.

sylvia: 48h is tight for the audit. Can we at least lock the schema changes so it doesn't regress other jobs? If you push a schema-only patch we can land that sooner.

omar: Yep I can split into two PRs: (1) schema lock, (2) retention tuning. Will open schema-first in ~1h.

ops-bot: Reminder: Action Item #2 assigned to omar is overdue (due 1806514834). Please update: https://tracker.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-128/actions.

patrick: If schema-first lands, ops can coordinate a rolling config push that doesn't require full deploy. That buys time for the retention tests.

omar: Schema PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4622. It includes a migration script and smoke test. ETA for merge: EOD.

sylvia: Reviewing now. Quick note: ensure the migration script is idempotent for private clusters.

omar: Added idempotency guard to the script and a short note in the PR. Running smoke.

[3h later]

omar: Smoke passed in staging, merged schema PR and queued retention tuning PR. Updated tracker and postmortem with a recurrence note: "private log retention disparities".

nina: Thanks 1. Can you link the tracker update? I'll verify and mark Action Item #2 closed if retention PR is flagged as follow-on.

omar: Tracker: https://tracker.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-128/actions#2. Marked as closed with follow-on task for retention tuning (low priority).

patrick: Noting for runbook: add a step to check "schema lock" before audits to avoid this churn.

sylvia: Agreed. I'll add to infra runbook.

nina: Verified tracker and PM updated. Closing action. Cheers. :white_check_mark:
